Katana / 100 designs

Recognizable Japanese-inspired katana: gently curved SINGLE-EDGED blade, clear cutting edge and spine, round or oval tsuba disk guard, long wrapped two-hand grip, small kashira end cap. All tiers remain katana. Never a medieval cruciform crossguard or a straight double-edged longsword.

Each row is one path. T1–T5 describe the visual stage within that path. Click artwork for a larger preview. Thumbnails are embedded when exports are present, so the finished browser travels with the native engine documentation.
